title: A note on the Möbius uncertainty principle for posets
summary: We consider two generalizations of Pollack's uncertainty principle for Möbius inversion to locally finite posets. The first generalization was previously studied by Goh. Here, we provide a simplified sufficient criterion for the uncertainty principle to hold. We also provide a necessary criterion for the same which, in particular, disproves Goh's conjectural characterization of posets for which an uncertainty principle holds. Nevertheless, we prove that Goh's conjecture indeed holds when the poset forms a lattice. The second generalization is new and applies to posets with reduced incidence…
